title: Save Toolkit team settings version 1
description: Optional team locations and incident display preferences. Validates data shape only: it does not verify real timezone existence, filesystem containment, accessibility, platform filename restrictions, or authorization. Consumers must resolve and check those separately. Missing optional values retain documented conventions and defaults; validation does not insert defaults.

root.description: Directory relative to the settings file, or . for that directory. External absolute roots must be supplied explicitly by the caller outside version 1 configuration.

display_timezone.description: UTC or a named IANA-shaped timezone, such as America/New_York. Shape validation does not prove the name exists in a timezone database; resolve the named zone before converting times. This affects display only, not UTC evidence or handoff timestamps.

relativePath.description: Nonempty relative path using forward slashes and nonempty components; ordinary spaces are allowed. No dot or dot-dot components, whitespace-only components, trailing slash, absolute/drive/UNC/URL forms, backslashes, control characters, shell variables, backticks or tilde expansion. Child paths resolve under knowledge.root.
